entries.label: customer_of
entries.text: is a customer of | relationship_type | One company buys goods or services from another.

entries.label: borrows_under
entries.text: borrows under | relationship_type | An entity is the borrower under a facility.

entries.label: stock_exchange
entries.text: Stock exchange | entity_type | A venue on which a security is listed.

entries.label: regulator
entries.text: Regulator | entity_type | A governmental or self-regulatory body with authority over the company.

entries.label: participates_in
entries.text: participates in | relationship_type | An entity takes part in an event, in a named role.

entries.label: common_stock
entries.text: Common stock | financial_instrument_type | Units of common equity ownership. Opendoor trades as OPEN.

entries.label: supplier_to
entries.text: is a supplier to | relationship_type | Inverse of CUSTOMER_OF.

entries.label: relationship_claim
entries.text: Relationship claim | claim_type | A claim that two entities stand in a declared relationship.

entries.label: adjusted_ebitda_margin_v1
entries.text: Adjusted EBITDA Margin | metric_formula | Adjusted EBITDA as a percentage of revenue.

entries.label: listing_compliance_event
entries.text: Listing compliance event | event_type | Exchange notice regarding continued listing standards, or regaining compliance. Opendoor received a Nasdaq minimum-bid-price notice.

entries.label: inventory_valuation_adjustment
entries.text: Inventory valuation adjustment | metric_definition | Inventory valuation adjustment | inventory impairment | Valuation adjustments | Adjustment to inventory carrying value. Feeds Adjusted Gross Profit. Called "inventory impairment" in earlier filings - see formula versions.

entries.label: regulator_role
entries.text: Regulator role | role_type | Body exercising regulatory authority in a specific matter.

entries.label: homes_under_resale_contract
entries.text: Homes under contract for sale | metric_definition | Inventory under contract for RESALE - the sell side. Not homes_under_contract, which is the buy side.

entries.label: asset_backed_debt_facility
entries.text: Asset-backed debt facility | agreement_type | Facility secured by homes in inventory. Opendoor's senior revolving facilities are secured per-home, with drawdowns made on a per-home basis.

entries.label: feature_launch
entries.text: Feature launch | event_type | A named feature of an existing product becomes available.

entries.label: geographic_market
entries.text: Geographic market | entity_type | A metropolitan market Opendoor operates in. The corpus reports a market count far more often than it names individual metros, so both a count metric and named instances are needed.

entries.label: product_discontinuation
entries.text: Product discontinuation | event_type | A named product or feature is withdrawn.

entries.label: partnership_announcement
entries.text: Partnership announcement | event_type | A commercial partnership is announced or entered into.

entries.label: warrant
entries.text: Warrant | financial_instrument_type | Right to purchase shares at a stated price. Opendoor lists warrant classes (OPENW, OPENZ) and has issued marketing warrants.

entries.label: available_in
entries.text: is available in | relationship_type | A product or feature is available in a market.

entries.label: reverse_stock_split
entries.text: Reverse stock split | event_type | Consolidation of outstanding shares. Recorded as its own type because it rebases every per-share figure, so observations either side of it are not directly comparable.

entries.label: listed_security
entries.text: Listed security | financial_instrument_type | A security listed on at least one exchange.

entries.label: party_to
entries.text: is a party to | relationship_type | Generic agreement participation, for agreements whose specific roles are not stated. Weaker than BORROWS_UNDER or LENDS_UNDER, and preferred over guessing which applies.

entries.label: adjusted_gross_margin
entries.text: Adjusted Gross Margin | metric_definition | Adjusted Gross Margin | Adjusted Gross Profit as a percentage of revenue.

entries.label: term_debt_facility
entries.text: Term debt facility | agreement_type | Facility with a fixed principal drawn and repaid on a schedule.

entries.label: earnings_release
entries.text: Earnings release | event_type | Publication of results for a fiscal period. The event that most metric observations hang off: the observation carries the value, the event carries the disclosure act.

entries.label: lender
entries.text: Lender | role_type | Party that extends credit under a facility.

entries.label: partner
entries.text: Partner | role_type | Counterparty in a commercial partnership. Time-bound by necessity - the same company may be a competitor in one period and a partner in another.

entries.label: adjusted_gross_profit_v2
entries.text: Adjusted Gross Profit (FY2022 onward terminology) | metric_formula | GAAP gross profit adjusted for the inventory valuation adjustment. The restructuring line no longer appears.

entries.label: operations_pause
entries.text: Operations pause | event_type | Temporary suspension of home buying, market-wide or company-wide. Opendoor paused buying in March 2020.

entries.label: revolving_credit_facility
entries.text: Revolving credit facility | agreement_type | Credit facility permitting withdraw, repay and withdraw again.

entries.label: pct_homes_on_market_gt_120_days
entries.text: Percentage of homes "on the market" for greater than 120 days (at period end) | metric_definition | Percentage of homes "on the market" for greater than 120 days (at period end) | percentage of homes on the market for greater than 120 days | homes had been listed on the market for more than 120 days | % of Homes on the market for greater than 120 Days | % of homes on the market over 120 Days | our portfolio | our homes | our homes in inventory | Share of homes listed longer than the threshold, measured from initial listing date, at period end. Reported quarterly. Published as a percentage only; no count found.

entries.label: market_exit
entries.text: Market exit | event_type | The company ceases operating in a metropolitan market.

entries.label: market_count
entries.text: Number of markets | metric_definition | Total Markets | markets | Count of metropolitan markets operated in, at a point in time.

entries.label: calculated
entries.text: Calculated value | evidence_type | A value re-derived from other observations. Its evidence is the derivation, not a source: given the inputs and the expression, anyone can recompute it.

entries.label: convertible_note
entries.text: Convertible note | financial_instrument_type | Debt convertible into equity under stated conditions.

entries.label: partnership_agreement
entries.text: Partnership agreement | agreement_type | Commercial agreement establishing a distribution or referral partnership.

entries.label: direct_selling_costs
entries.text: Direct selling costs | metric_definition | direct selling costs | Direct selling costs | Selling costs directly attributable to homes sold in the period.

entries.label: share_repurchase
entries.text: Share repurchase | event_type | Authorization or execution of a buyback of the company's own shares.

entries.label: disclosure_channel
entries.text: Disclosure channel | entity_type | A medium through which the company discloses information. Carries canonicality so a live dashboard is never mistaken for reproducible filed evidence.

entries.label: inventory_balance
entries.text: Inventory (at period end) | metric_definition | Inventory (at period end) | Inventory | Carrying value of real-estate inventory at period end.

entries.label: contribution_margin
entries.text: Contribution Margin | metric_definition | Contribution Margin | Contribution Margin (Loss) | Contribution Profit as a percentage of revenue.

entries.label: acquisition_contracts
entries.text: Acquisition contracts | metric_definition | acquisition contracts | weekly acquisition contracts | Count of acquisition contracts signed DURING a period. Reported quarterly in filings and weekly on the company dashboard. Distinct from homes_under_contract, which is a period-end snapshot.

entries.label: reported_in
entries.text: is reported in | relationship_type | An observation or event was disclosed through a channel or document.

entries.label: adjusted_gross_profit
entries.text: Adjusted Gross Profit | metric_definition | Adjusted Gross Profit | Adjusted Gross Profit (Loss) | GAAP gross profit adjusted for inventory valuation effects. Formula changed over time - see formulas.yaml.

entries.label: market_data
entries.text: Market data row | evidence_type | One row of a price or market series from a data provider. Not a disclosure: nobody filed it, and it is reproducible only against the provider, the series and the row.

entries.label: mortgage_rate
entries.text: Mortgage rate | metric_definition | mortgage rate | mortgage rates | Prevailing mortgage interest rate, an external market driver.

entries.label: company
entries.text: Company | entity_type | A legal entity that can own assets, enter agreements and be a counterparty.

entries.label: fiscal_period
entries.text: Fiscal period | entity_type | A reporting period a metric observation is attributed to.

entries.label: contribution_margin_v1
entries.text: Contribution Margin | metric_formula | Contribution Profit as a percentage of revenue.

entries.label: contribution_profit_after_interest_v1
entries.text: Contribution Profit After Interest | metric_formula | Contribution Profit less senior revolving facility interest on homes sold.

entries.label: xbrl_fact
entries.text: XBRL fact | evidence_type | A tagged fact in an inline-XBRL document. The strongest evidence available - it carries its own period, unit and context.

entries.label: market_entry
entries.text: Market entry | event_type | The company begins operating in a metropolitan market.

entries.label: has_subsidiary
entries.text: has subsidiary | relationship_type | Inverse of SUBSIDIARY_OF.

entries.label: home_price_appreciation
entries.text: Home price appreciation | metric_definition | home price appreciation | HPA | Rate of change in home prices in a market.

entries.label: competes_with
entries.text: competes with | relationship_type | Competitive relationship as stated in a filing, typically a risk factor. Symmetric, and time-bound because the corpus shows the same counterparty later as a partner.

entries.label: subsidiary
entries.text: Subsidiary | entity_type | A company controlled by another company. Sourced from EX-21.1 exhibits.

entries.label: collateral
entries.text: Collateral | agreement_type | Assets pledged as security. For Opendoor, homes in inventory.

entries.label: adjusted_gross_profit_v1
entries.text: Adjusted Gross Profit (FY2020-FY2021 terminology) | metric_formula | GAAP gross profit adjusted for inventory impairment and restructuring, as reconciled in FY2020 and FY2021 filings.

entries.label: guidance_issuance
entries.text: Guidance issuance | event_type | Forward-looking targets for a future period. Kept apart from earnings_release so a guided figure is never mistaken for a reported one.

entries.label: pct_homes_on_market_gt_120_days
entries.text: Percentage of homes "on the market" for greater than 120 days (at period end) | metric_definition | Percentage of homes "on the market" for greater than 120 days (at period end) | percentage of homes on the market for greater than 120 days | homes had been listed on the market for more than 120 days | % of Homes on the market for greater than 120 Days | % of homes on the market over 120 Days | Share of homes listed longer than the threshold, measured from initial listing date, at period end. Reported quarterly. Published as a percentage only; no count found.

entries.label: facility_status
entries.text: Facility status | status_type | Lifecycle state of a debt facility.

entries.label: credit_facility_established
entries.text: Credit facility established | event_type | A new debt facility is entered into.

entries.label: securities_issuance
entries.text: Securities issuance | event_type | The company issues equity, warrants or convertible notes.

entries.label: homes_purchased
entries.text: Homes purchased | metric_definition | Homes Purchased | homes acquired | home acquisition volumes | Count of homes whose acquisition CLOSED during the period. Not contracts signed.

entries.label: person
entries.text: Person | entity_type | A natural person, typically an officer or director.

entries.label: holding_costs
entries.text: Holding costs | metric_definition | holding costs | Holding costs | Costs of holding homes in inventory. A Contribution Profit input, split into current period and prior periods on homes sold this period.

entries.label: regulated_by
entries.text: is regulated by | relationship_type | A company falls under a regulator's authority.

entries.label: management_objective
entries.text: Management objective | entity_type | A company-declared accountability objective binding an objective to the metrics it is tracked by. Present in earnings releases from Q3 2025 as the "Management Objective | How You Can Hold Us Accountable | How We're Executing" table.

entries.label: uses_formula_version
entries.text: uses formula version | relationship_type | Which dated formula produced a calculated observation.

entries.label: borrowing_capacity
entries.text: Borrowing capacity | metric_definition | borrowing capacity | Borrowing capacity | Committed and uncommitted capacity available under debt facilities.

entries.label: adjusted_gross_margin_v1
entries.text: Adjusted Gross Margin | metric_formula | Adjusted Gross Profit as a percentage of revenue.

entries.label: guaranteed_by
entries.text: is guaranteed by | relationship_type | An obligation is guaranteed by an entity other than the borrower.

entries.label: adjusted_ebitda
entries.text: Adjusted EBITDA | metric_definition | Adjusted EBITDA | Non-GAAP earnings measure reconciled to net loss.

entries.label: listing_status
entries.text: Listing compliance status | status_type | Standing against an exchange's continued-listing standards.

entries.label: issuer
entries.text: Issuer | role_type | Party that issues a financial instrument.

entries.label: collateral_provider
entries.text: Collateral provider | role_type | Party pledging assets to secure an obligation.

entries.label: adjusted_ebitda_margin
entries.text: Adjusted EBITDA Margin | metric_definition | Adjusted EBITDA Margin | Adjusted EBITDA as a percentage of revenue.

entries.label: partnered_with
entries.text: is partnered with | relationship_type | Commercial partnership between two companies.

entries.label: contribution_profit_after_interest
entries.text: Contribution Profit After Interest | metric_definition | Contribution Profit After Interest | Contribution Profit less interest expense under senior revolving credit facilities incurred on homes sold during the period, which may include interest recorded in prior periods.

entries.label: borrower
entries.text: Borrower | role_type | Party obligated to repay amounts drawn under a facility.

entries.label: product_status
entries.text: Product status | status_type | Lifecycle state of a product or feature.

entries.label: operates_in
entries.text: operates in | relationship_type | A company operates in a geographic market.

entries.label: issued
entries.text: issued | relationship_type | A company issued a financial instrument.

entries.label: homes_under_contract
entries.text: Homes under contract to purchase | metric_definition | homes under contract | in contract to purchase | homes under contract to purchase | Count of homes under signed purchase contract but not yet closed, AT period end. Reported with a companion aggregate purchase price.

entries.label: holds_position_at
entries.text: holds position at | relationship_type | A person holds an officer or director position at a company.

entries.label: secured_by
entries.text: is secured by | relationship_type | A facility is secured by pledged assets - for Opendoor, homes in inventory.

entries.label: supersedes
entries.text: supersedes | relationship_type | A restated or amended figure replaces an earlier one. The earlier observation is kept, not overwritten - what was originally reported is itself a fact.

entries.label: reconciles_to
entries.text: reconciles to | relationship_type | A non-GAAP metric reconciles to a GAAP metric. NOT equivalence - the pair are different measures and must stay separate concepts.

entries.label: metric_observation_claim
entries.text: Metric observation claim | claim_type | A claim that a metric had a value for a subject over a period.

entries.label: revenue
entries.text: Revenue | metric_definition | Revenue | Revenue (GAAP) | Total Revenue | GAAP revenue for the period.

entries.label: corporate_acquisition
entries.text: Corporate acquisition | event_type | The company acquires another entity or business.

entries.label: lends_under
entries.text: lends under | relationship_type | An entity is a lender under a facility. The role is scoped to the facility - the same counterparty may lend under one and not another.

entries.label: filing_metadata
entries.text: Filing metadata | evidence_type | Submission-level metadata - accession, form, filing date, items.

entries.label: gaap_gross_profit
entries.text: Gross profit (GAAP) | metric_definition | Gross profit (GAAP) | Gross profit | GAAP gross profit for the period.

entries.label: acquired
entries.text: acquired | relationship_type | One entity acquired another.

entries.label: has_observation
entries.text: has observation | relationship_type | A metric definition has a measured observation.

entries.label: cost_of_revenue
entries.text: Cost of revenue | metric_definition | GAAP cost of revenue for the period.

entries.label: normalized_table
entries.text: Normalized table | evidence_type | A table extracted during normalization, addressed by table id.

entries.label: credit_facility_terminated
entries.text: Credit facility terminated | event_type | A facility is repaid in full and closed, or otherwise terminated.

entries.label: credit_facility_amended
entries.text: Credit facility amended | event_type | Terms of an existing facility change - capacity, maturity or pricing. A separate type from establishment because a capacity change is not a new facility.

entries.label: employment_agreement
entries.text: Employment agreement | agreement_type | Offer letter or employment arrangement with an officer. EX-10.x exhibits.

entries.label: computed_from
entries.text: is computed from | relationship_type | A calculated observation's inputs. Present only on observations whose assertion_type is `calculated`; a reported figure has no inputs and must not carry this.

entries.label: resale_cohort
entries.text: Resale cohort | entity_type | The set of homes sold in a given period. Required because Contribution Profit is explicitly a cohort measure: it pulls in costs incurred in prior periods on homes sold this period and excludes costs on unsold inventory.

entries.label: workforce_reduction
entries.text: Workforce reduction | event_type | A reduction in force or restructuring affecting headcount.

entries.label: financial_instrument
entries.text: Financial instrument | financial_instrument_type | Abstract parent for issued instruments.

entries.label: market_status
entries.text: Market status | status_type | Whether the company is operating in a market.

entries.label: housing_inventory_homes
entries.text: Homes in inventory | metric_definition | Homes in Inventory | homes in inventory (at period end) | Count of homes owned and unsold at period end.

entries.label: executive_change
entries.text: Executive change | event_type | Appointment, departure or role change of an officer or director. One type with a `change_kind` property rather than three near-identical types.

entries.label: agreement
entries.text: Agreement | agreement_type | Abstract parent for contractual arrangements.

entries.label: feature
entries.text: Feature | entity_type | A capability within a product, launched and tracked separately.

entries.label: distinct_from
entries.text: is distinct from | relationship_type | Two metrics that must never be merged or aliased to one another. Carries the research's most load-bearing finding into the graph itself.

entries.label: contribution_profit_v1
entries.text: Contribution Profit (Loss) | metric_formula | Adjusted Gross Profit less holding and direct selling costs attributable to homes sold during the period.

entries.label: gaap_gross_margin_v1
entries.text: Gross Margin | metric_formula | GAAP gross profit as a percentage of revenue.

entries.label: offers
entries.text: offers | relationship_type | A company offers a product.

entries.label: homes_sold
entries.text: Homes sold | metric_definition | Homes Sold | Total homes sold | Number of homes sold | Resale Closes | Count of homes resold by the company during the period.

entries.label: observation_of_subject
entries.text: is an observation of | relationship_type | An observation measures a specific subject entity.

entries.label: product_launch
entries.text: Product launch | event_type | A named product becomes available.

entries.label: credit_facility
entries.text: Credit facility | agreement_type | Credit agreement allowing periodic drawdowns over an extended period rather than reapplying each time funds are needed.

entries.label: event_claim
entries.text: Event claim | claim_type | A claim that an event of a declared type occurred.

entries.label: product
entries.text: Product | entity_type | A customer-facing offering, e.g. a selling or buying product line.

entries.label: listed_on
entries.text: is listed on | relationship_type | A security trades on an exchange.

entries.label: normalized_passage
entries.text: Normalized passage | evidence_type | A passage from the normalized corpus, addressed by passage id.

entries.label: public_company
entries.text: Public company | entity_type | A company whose shares are traded and held publicly.

entries.label: external_page
entries.text: External page | evidence_type | A page outside EDGAR, such as the company dashboard. Its channel's canonicality decides whether it may support a historical claim.

entries.label: credit_agreement
entries.text: Credit agreement | agreement_type | Agreement under which a debtor receives value and agrees to repay.

entries.label: subsidiary_of
entries.text: is a subsidiary of | relationship_type | Ownership of one entity by another. Sourced from EX-21.1.

entries.label: evidenced_by
entries.text: is evidenced by | relationship_type | The citation edge. Every asserted claim resolves to at least one of these; without it the claim is unverifiable and validation rejects it.

entries.label: acquirer
entries.text: Acquirer | role_type | Party acquiring another entity or business.

entries.label: gaap_gross_margin
entries.text: Gross Margin | metric_definition | Gross Margin | GAAP gross profit as a percentage of revenue.

entries.label: feature_of
entries.text: is a feature of | relationship_type | A feature belongs to a product.

entries.label: contribution_profit
entries.text: Contribution Profit (Loss) | metric_definition | Contribution Profit | Contribution Profit (Loss) | Adjusted Gross Profit less holding and direct selling costs on homes sold in the period. A cohort measure: it deliberately includes costs incurred in prior periods on homes sold this period and excludes costs on unsold inventory.

entries.label: material_agreement
entries.text: Material agreement | agreement_type | Agreement material enough to require disclosure. Parent for agreement types reported under SEC Item 1.01.

entries.label: acquisition_target
entries.text: Acquisition target | role_type | Entity or business being acquired.
